'''Oasis East''', also nicknamed the '''abandoned Oasis''', was the designation given to a small body of [[Water/Legends|water]] located south of the [[Krayt Graveyard]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. This oasis was often mistaken for a mirage, given its near-perfect circular shape. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], a number of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] visited this oasis, and considered it to be one of Tatooine's greatest vistas.<ref name="SWG:PVT">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Panoramic Vistas: Tatooine}}</ref> The body of water was surrounded by [[Palm tree/Legends|palm trees]] and other [[Plant/Legends|vegetation]]. Though the water was mostly shallow, parts of it were deep enough to swim in. The water was also home to a number of [[Species/Legends|lifeforms]], particularly various [[Fish/Legends|fish]] varieties. Indeed, [[Fishing/Legends|fishing]] at the oasis was possible for anyone who desired to do so.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|South of what some refer to as the Graveyard, the body of water in this Oasis is often mistaken as a mirage, given its near-perfect circular shape.|In-game description of the Oasis|<ref name="SWG:PVT" />}}
Oasis East was one of four bodies of water on the [[:w:c:swg:Planet|planet]] [[:w:c:swg:Tatooine|Tatooine]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The other three were the [[Imperial Oasis]], the [[Oasis Northeast|Northeastern Oasis]], and the [[Oasis South|Southern Oasis]].<ref name="SWG" />

Players had to visit this oasis in order to complete the in-game "Panoramic Vistas" collection. The oasis had two names in the game. The "Panoramic Vistas" collection simply called it an "abandoned Oasis," while the search feature called it "Oasis East."<ref name="SWG" />
